::: {.fims-onboarding-header}
## Welcome!
<p>Let's get you set up to run your first model in FIMS.</p>
<h3><i class="bi bi-signpost-split"></i> New User Pathway</h3>
:::

::: {.fims-timeline}

::: {.fims-step .fims-timeline-item}
::: {.fims-step-number}
01
:::
::: {.fims-step-content}
<h4>Introduce Yourself</h4>
<p>Join the community and tell us about your research.</p>
<a href="https://github.com/orgs/NOAA-FIMS/discussions/801" class="fims-btn-small fims-task-btn">Start <i class="bi bi-arrow-right"></i></a>
:::
:::

::: {.fims-step .fims-timeline-item}
::: {.fims-step-number}
02
:::
::: {.fims-step-content}
<h4>Complete the Introductory Vignette</h4>
<p>Walk through the initial setup and familiarize yourself with the interface.</p>
<a href="https://noaa-fims.github.io/FIMS/articles/fims-demo.html" class="fims-btn-small fims-task-btn">Start <i class="bi bi-arrow-right"></i></a>
:::
:::

::: {.fims-step .fims-timeline-item}
::: {.fims-step-number}
03
:::
::: {.fims-step-content}
<h4>Diagnostics</h4>
<p>Run diagnostic checks to ensure your model is properly configured.</p>
<a href="https://noaa-fims.github.io/FIMSdiags/articles/index.html" class="fims-btn-small fims-task-btn">Start <i class="bi bi-arrow-right"></i></a>
:::
:::

::: {.fims-step .fims-timeline-item}
::: {.fims-step-number}
04
:::
::: {.fims-step-content}
<h4>FIMS Functions Overview</h4>
<p>Learn about the different functions available in FIMS and how to use them.</p>
<a href="https://noaa-fims.github.io/FIMS/reference/index.html" class="fims-btn-small fims-task-btn">Start <i class="bi bi-arrow-right"></i></a>
:::
:::

::: {.fims-step .fims-timeline-item .is-last}
::: {.fims-step-number}
05
:::
::: {.fims-step-content}
<h4>Transition to FIMS</h4>
<p>Learn about transitioning to FIMS from other frameworks and how to adapt your workflow.</p>
<a href="transitioning.qmd" class="fims-btn-small fims-task-btn">Start <i class="bi bi-arrow-right"></i></a>
:::
:::
